name: vLLM-Metal
notable_features: A vLLM hardware plugin, not a fork: upstream vLLM supplies the API server, the scheduler and the paged block manager, mlx_lm supplies the token-wise model layers, and the plugin owns the request-aware attention path
Unified paged varlen Metal kernel is the default attention backend as of v0.2.0, which the project credits with 83x TTFT and 3.6x throughput versus v0.1.0
Uses M5 NAX tensor units for MHA, GQA and MQA prefill
Speculative decoding support in the plugin
OpenAI-compatible API server, installable via Homebrew or a curl installer that needs no compiler
hardware_caveats: Apple Silicon on macOS 15 (Sequoia) or newer only - there is no other backend and no non-Apple path
It is community maintained, not upstream vLLM. vLLM's own install docs point at it as a separate package, so its feature set and stability track the plugin, not vLLM
Works best with models from the mlx-community HF org that were quantized for MLX; other checkpoints may not hit the tuned paths
Model coverage is a growing set with a separate supported-models matrix, so an architecture not on that list is unsupported
Kernel gains are hardware-generation specific - the NAX prefill acceleration is an M5 feature and does not exist on earlier Apple Silicon
best_for: Running vLLM's serving semantics (paged KV, continuous batching, prefix caching) on a Mac
Local development against a vLLM-compatible API on Apple Silicon
Serving a model that fits in unified memory with acceptable single-user latency
avoid_for: Multi-tenant datacenter serving - unified memory bandwidth does not compete with HBM
Non-Apple Silicon, or macOS older than 15
Production use where the plugin's release cadence and community-maintained status are unacceptable risk; upstream vLLM itself treats this as a community path
notes: Splitting from [[vllm]]: vLLM upstream has no Metal backend of its own and documents vLLM-Metal as the path for Apple Silicon.
